proof_gate: undirected components of a finite functional graph equal directed cycle count
CRT decomposes affine map into prime-power dynamical systems; product cycles combine by gcd/lcm
for p|A the p-primary map contracts to one fixed periodic point
for unit A with A!=1 mod p translate the unique fixed point to multiplication and count valuation strata by multiplicative order
for A==1 mod p use f^k(x)-x=S_k((A-1)x+B), valuation strata of the affine h-map, and minimal p-power k annihilating S_k

independent_exact.method: full configuration graph BFS shortest paths

proof_gate: for M=2 every good path coloring is isolated under a single +/-1 move
for M>=3 each good modular sequence has a unique integer lift up to global +qM in chamber 0<X[i+1]-X[i]<M
legal operations are unit-coordinate moves that stay in the same chamber

between two integer points of this path difference-constraint chamber, a coordinate that moves toward target can always be chosen; blocker propagation terminates unless M=2, so an L1-monotone geodesic exists
target lifts are Y+qM; minimizing path length is min_q sum_i |Y_i+qM-X_i|, a one-dimensional convex median problem
